quarterly_data.signal: Full Phase 3 CROSSING results (Amgen and AstraZeneca; late-breaking at UEG Week 2026) for TEZSPIRE in eosinophilic esophagitis: histologic remission at week 24 was 64.8% (210 mg) and 68.9% (420 mg) versus 3.5% on placebo (p<0.001), and DSQ dysphagia scores fell 18.8 points (210 mg; p=0.049) and 22.0 points (420 mg; p<0.001) versus 14.7 points on placebo. At week 52 histologic remission was 67.8% and 63.3% versus 5.4%, DSQ reductions 22.1 and 24.0 points versus 13.2, and total endoscopic remission 34.4% and 29.5% versus 4.1% (p<0.001); safety was consistent with approved indications.
